source_line: Sources: MCX via Business Today; our market brief (20 Nov 2026).
reasons: Markets price a ~95% chance of a US rate hike in
December; one governor floated 50 bps. Gold pays
no interest, so higher rates weigh on it.
The dollar is near a 19-month high and the
10-year US yield is above 5% - both pull
Gold is ~33% below its early-2026 record and
having its worst year since 2015; profit-taking
and margin calls add to the selling.
circuit: No. Gold did NOT hit a lower circuit - trading was
orderly. MCX applies staggered margins, not a single
price band, so a sharp fall does not freeze trade.
month: The 10 Dec US Fed meeting decides the direction.
Markets expect a rate hike; the dot-plot and
Chair's tone matter more than the hike itself.
Watch FOMC minutes, US jobs and inflation first.
scenarios: $3,500-3,475 (~Rs 1.22 lakh) is the support in focus; a break opens lower.
If the Fed softens its tone
a relief bounce is likely; central-bank buying is a longer-term floor.
